translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Isn't that the reception over there?」

と、あなた達を男の怒声が出迎えた。

男は前髪で表情こそ確認できないが、
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: The man’s expression couldn't be seen due to his bangs,

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: but it was easy to imagine he was glaring sharply at the woman

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Last year and the year before that I was told the same and sent away.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: I've grown since then, so this year should be fine.」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「いいからよく見ろよ、
お前ちゃんと見たんだろうな」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「I looked, I looked, I looked properlyー」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Come a bit closer from the reception――」

男と一緒にいた女性が、

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: put her hands on her hips and let out a big sigh.
